title: Sunderland close on £6m Manchester United duo Paddy McNair and Donald Love
trail: Paddy McNair and Donald Love are set to swap Manchester United for Sunderland after the clubs agreed a joint fee for the pair believed to be in the region of £6m
body: Paddy McNair and Donald Love are set to swap Manchester United for Sunderland after the clubs agreed a joint fee for the pair believed to be in the region of £6m. Providing they both pass medicals, the pair are expected to sign four-year contracts by the end of Wednesday. David Moyes, Sunderland’s new manager, knows the players from his Old Trafford days and believes they can help address problem positions in the squad he has inherited from England’s new manager, Sam Allardyce. McNair is a 21-year-old centre-half who can also operate at right-back, right wing-back and in central midfield. He has 11 full Northern Ireland caps and was part of the squad which competed in France 2016. Also 21, Love is a right-back who spent part of last season on loan at Wigan. Coincidentally he made his senior debut for United against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light in February. Although McNair and Love have their admirers at Old Trafford they were likely to be restricted to fringe roles under José Mourinho this season and the move is regarded as being in the best interests of all parties. It also enables Moyes – who is keen to buy British players wherever possible – to bolster a defence which could soon lose the influential Lamine Koné, the subject of a bid from Everton. Sunderland’s manager wants Phil Jagielka in part exchange but the Merseysiders are reluctant to release their captain.
